recap.text: Carl's father's red and beige 1965 Harley Davidson FLH Panhead Electra Glide comes up as prize four on Chaco's carousel, after two skill potions, five hundred bombs and two thousand books. Carl's heart stops at the small dent on the gas tank, left the day his father took a belt to him. Donut pictures Carl on the bike and her on Mongo, but Carl wants to pick it only to push it onto the tracks.

Donut recognizes the dented Harley from the prize carousel and knows Carl's father is inside the trailer beside it. Carl lifts the dusty, weed-ringed bike into his inventory with the royal chariot and the bicycles. He finds the keys in his father's dresser, and the bike starts at once on a full tank. In Guanajay past midnight, Donut calls it a metallic penis extension with a free probation officer, and Samantha thinks it is sexy.

With sixty seconds of invulnerability left, Carl rides his father's motorcycle across the arena at Scolopendra, Donut on his shoulder and refusing to get off. Eris swaps every inventory, so Donut has Carl's, and she combines the ball in slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve, then drops the ball into his scoop. Carl yanks the bike down hard, launching them into the air, and flings the ball into the boss's mouth. Scolopendra splatters into a puddle.

beats.headline: Prize four
beats.text: On Chaco's prize carousel, after two skill potions, five hundred bombs and two thousand books, comes prize four: a 1965 Harley Davidson FLH Panhead Electra Glide, red and beige. Carl's heart stops at the small dent on the gas tank. He slipped once coming up the driveway and knocked his father's motorcycle over, and that was the one day his father was physically abusive: a belt, hard enough to draw blood. Is it really his? Donut thinks Carl on the bike and her on Mongo would be unstoppable. Carl has an urge to pick it only to push it onto the tracks in front of a train.
beats.gist: Carl sees his father's red and beige Harley as prize four and wants to wreck it.

beats.headline: Donut knows the bike
beats.text: Donut has worked out who the keyholder will be before Carl has, and the second clue is the motorcycle: the same one he was offered on the prize carousel on the fourth floor, with the big dent in it. She remembers how it affected him, though he said nothing at the time. Now it is sitting outside a trailer, and she just knows his father will be inside. She is trying to be more like Carl, she says, and not give them the satisfaction.
beats.gist: Donut guesses Carl's father is the keyholder because his motorcycle, dented, sits outside the trailer.

beats.headline: Into Carl's inventory
beats.text: In the trailer's yard the Harley is dirty and dusty, its leather seat cracked, weeds growing round its tyres, its Georgia plates expired years ago. Carl knows nothing about it except that it is a collector's item, that his father never shut up about it, and that it was his prized possession. He picks it up easily, remembering how heavy it was the day he knocked it over. It goes into his inventory, not into the temporary category like everything else from this floor, but in with the royal chariot and the bicycles: Shitty Transportation Items.
beats.gist: Carl picks up his father's dusty, expired-plated Harley easily, and it goes into his inventory as Shitty Transportation.

beats.headline: A full tank
beats.text: In his father's dresser Carl found the keys to the motorcycle and the Ford truck. Going out, he starts to pull the royal chariot from his inventory, then has a thought, pulls his father's motorcycle instead, sticks the keys in and tries to start it. To his utter astonishment it roars to life at once. The gas tank is full. He gets on, and off he goes.
beats.gist: Carl finds his father's keys, pulls the Harley instead of the chariot, and it starts at once.

beats.headline: A metallic penis extension
beats.text: In the small town of Guanajay, past midnight, Carl pulls out the Harley, and Donut, in Mongo's saddle, looks it up and down with distaste and asks whether he means to grow a mullet as well. The goblin copper chopper was custom-made for them, she says, with a sidecar and a tailor-made seat; this is a metallic penis extension that comes with a free probation officer and a traumatic brain injury. Carl reminds her she tried to get him to pick this exact motorcycle on the carousel. She denies it: she wanted the chaps. Samantha thinks it is sexy.
beats.gist: Carl pulls out his father's Harley in Guanajay, and Donut mocks it as a metallic penis extension.

beats.headline: Laid down at Scolopendra
beats.text: With sixty seconds of invulnerability left, Carl rides his motorcycle across the arena at Scolopendra, Donut on his shoulder and refusing to get off. Eris swaps every inventory, so Donut has his, and he has her combine the ball in slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve. She drops the ball into his scoop. Carl yanks the bike down hard, launching them both into the air, and flings the ball into the boss's mouth. Scolopendra splatters into a puddle, and the motorcycle spins off the other way as they tumble to a stop.
beats.gist: Carl rides his father's motorcycle at Scolopendra and flings a ball into its mouth.
